ModMetaData.name: RimKata
ModMetaData.author: KRWF
ModMetaData.description:
Close-range gun kata combat enabled by RimKata-A, RimKata-P, RimKata-G, RimKata-I, or the optional mind-numb serum dependency gene.
The core RimKata-A route requires no DLC. Royalty adds RimKata-P, Biotech adds RimKata-G, Anomaly and Biotech add the mind-numb serum dependency gene and creepjoiner integration, and Ideology adds the RimKata-I role.
